in_hebrew.name: רודיגר
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the German name Rudiger, which is composed of the Old High German words 'hrod' meaning 'fame' and 'wigr' meaning 'war'. In Hebrew, it is transliterated as רודיגר (Rudiger) and its meaning is 'red knight'.

in_greek.name: Ρουδίγερος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Rudiger in Greek is transliterated as Ρουδίγερος (Roudigeros) and its meaning is 'strong in war'. This is derived from the Germanic roots 'hrod' meaning 'fame' and 'wigr' meaning 'war', which are translated to the Greek words 'ρόδος' (rodos) meaning 'glory, fame' and 'πολεμικός' (polemikos) meaning 'warlike'.

in_latin.name: Rudiger
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Rudiger in Latin is the same as in English. Its meaning is 'strong ruler', derived from the Old High German roots 'hrod' meaning 'fame' and 'wigr' meaning 'war'.
